notes: Replication title verified against supplied reference. Author-hosted accepted preprint acquired from https://mgto.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Ziano-et-al-2021-JOEP-Disjunction-effect-replication-extension-preprint-final.pdf . Supplied replication p.7 locator differs from preprint pagination: Table 1 begins on p.7, while replication omnibus row is p.9 and narrative test p.17. Selected between-subject omnibus test matching original design and description; within-subject extension and pairwise tests not merged. Replication paper also reconstructs original statistics, but these were not substituted for unavailable original primary text. Replication narrative rounds Fail percentage to 15% whereas Table 1 prints 16%; this does not alter the selected printed omnibus values.
